content.text: Let me check the link hrefs and fetch all pages via eval.

input.command: orca eval --expression "(async()=>{let rows=[];for(let p=1;p<=10;p++){const t=await (await fetch('/k2-table/?page='+p)).text();const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(t,'text/html');d.querySelectorAll('tbody tr, table tr').forEach(r=>{const c=[...r.querySelectorAll('td')].map(x=>x.textContent.trim());if(c.length)rows.push(c)})}const ids=new Set(rows.map(r=>r[0]));const m=rows.filter(r=>r[1]==='Northwind'&&r[3]==='overdue');const cents=m.reduce((s,r)=>s+Math.round(parseFloat(r[2].replace(/[$,]/g,''))*100),0);return JSON.stringify({n:rows.length,uniq:ids.size,custs:[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r[1]))],stats:[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r[3]))],m,count:m.length,total:cents/100})})()" --json
input.description: Fetch all pages and sum matching invoices
